questions.prompt: What exact event counts as a false blocking incident during report-only Probe dogfood?

options.label: Enforcement effects only
options.description: Count only a nonzero gate exit, blocked result, or denied Kanban transition caused by Probe.

options.label: Any workflow interruption
options.description: Count any user-visible interruption attributable to Probe, even when the gate remains advisory.

options.label: Track both separately
options.description: Maintain separate enforcement-effect and user-interruption rates in the baseline.

questions.prompt: Does the initial dirty-worktree bootstrap session count toward the five-spec E2E and fourteen-day baseline, or must counting begin with a clean committed source revision?

options.label: Clean revisions only
options.description: Retain the bootstrap as evidence but start acceptance counting with the first clean committed source revision.

options.label: Portable hashes suffice
options.description: Count the bootstrap when every input and rendered artifact is content-addressed and gate-valid.

options.label: Separate bootstrap metric
options.description: Track bootstrap use separately from the five qualifying E2Es and fourteen-day baseline.
